items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: I became good friends with Walter and Walter used to teach me.

ctx.x: Well I bet you wanted to be a musician at that time. Yeah.

Then I began to play a little cheap jobs for a dollar and a half. And what you could drink was just fun to me. The money didn't mean anything. I mean we just loved to play you know. And I'd get a drum and piano and my singing helped me out a whole lot. So I still was bumming with this little guy at Boynton San Diego. And he was a fellow, he didn't like to play for money. He liked to play for pleasure. And he had a little job at the Pelican N.A.s. And he quit the job. And I had sit in with them a couple of times.…
Was he working on the boat those days or right at the top?
